As a single task, it doesn't require a dependency chain but is straightforward to verify and doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge beyond knowing what a smoker looks like (a furnace-like block with a distinct texture). The scene can be designed with the smoker placed at a specific location that requires some navigation to find.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the smoker and be facing toward it to demonstrate they have located it. The smoker is at spawn-relative [5, 1, 7] inside a small oak hut. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered or is at the entrance of the building. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the smoker, not just passing by. The player starts ~8.7 blocks away so this is not trivially satisfied at spawn.

scene_description: A small oak plank hut on a cobblestone foundation located ~5-7 blocks from spawn. The hut has a wide 3-block entrance on the south side. Inside the hut are a smoker (back center, facing south toward the entrance), a crafting table (left side), and a barrel (right side). The player must navigate to the building and enter it to find the smoker.
task_text: Find the smoker block inside the nearby building.
design_notes: The smoker is placed at ~5 ~1 ~7 (facing south toward the entrance). The building entrance is 3 blocks wide at ~4-6 ~1-2 ~5. The player spawns at ~0 ~0 ~0 and needs to walk roughly 7-8 blocks to reach the entrance. The scene is compact and the task is achievable within 20 steps. Wall torches were removed to avoid placement errors. The smoker's south-facing orientation ensures its distinctive front texture is visible when entering through the south entrance.
